//: Operator keys for LuuvCRM. Copy the ones you need into
sites/<your-site>/site_config.json — this file is documentation, not config.
Frappe already keeps the database password there; this is the same place,
which is why it is also the right one for these. Never in git.
_about_luuvcrm_passive: set luuvcrm_passive to 1 on a site that has the app installed but is not a restaurant (a shared bench): the request hooks and the patches stay out of it
// print templates: Google Doc ids for the printed layouts. The docs are shared 'anyone with the link', so an id is a capability — treat it like a key.
// everything else: Brand name, WhatsApp numbers and the pickup outlet belong to the restaurant, not the deployment — they live in LuuvCRM Settings in the Desk. Run `bench --site <site> execute luuvcrm.config.describe` to see every key, where it lives, and whether it is still on its default.
